publisher: European Commission, Directorate-General for Economic and Financial Affairs (DG ECFIN)

ALCD0.title: Adjusted wage share: total economy: as percentage of GDP at current prices (Compensation per employee as percentage of GDP at market prices per person employed.)

ALCD2.title: Adjusted wage share: total economy: as percentage of GDP at current factor cost (Compensation per employee as percentage of GDP at factor cost per person employed.)
ALCD2.unit_as_published: Percentage of GDP at factor cost

UTVT.title: Taxes linked to imports and production: total economy

UTVN.title: Taxes linked to imports and production minus subsidies: total economy

UQGD.title: Gross operating surplus: total economy :- Adjusted for imputed compensation of self-employed

HWCDW.title: Nominal compensation per employee: total economy

UVGD.title: Gross domestic product at current prices

UYGD.title: Gross domestic product at current factor cost

NETD.title: Employment, persons: all domestic industries (National accounts)

NWTD.title: Employees, persons: all domestic industries (National accounts)

NSTD.title: Number of self-employed: total economy (National accounts)

NELN.title: Employment (national) from LFS, persons: total economy

cross_format_verification.scope: Two separately downloaded formats from the SAME publisher and vintage; not independent empirical evidence.
cross_format_verification.method: Exact trimmed source-field equality, including missing-value tokens, before numerical conversion.

accounting_reconstruction.monetary_unit_2024: billion EUR (the source legacy unit label is Mrd EURO-PTE)
accounting_reconstruction.employment_unit: thousand persons, domestic national accounts for NETD, NWTD and NSTD
accounting_reconstruction.adjustment_assumption: Impute the same average compensation per head to self-employed as to employees; this is an accounting proxy, not observed self-employed labor earnings.
accounting_reconstruction.factor_cost_gdp_identity: UYGD = UVGD - UTVN = UWCD + UOGD, within published rounding
accounting_reconstruction.adjusted_factor_income_identity: UYGD = adjusted_labor_income + UQGD, within published rounding
accounting_reconstruction.tolerance_reason: Source rows are rounded to five decimal places; reconstruction is not expected to be bit-exact.

population_reconciliation.decision: Use domestic national-accounts employment consistently for this income-accounting identity. Do not replace NETD with national NETN or LFS NELN, or infer labor-market parameters from these aggregates.
population_reconciliation.remaining_gate: Document the bridge from this domestic production-income account to the resident labor-force and occupation universes before joint model calibration.

model_mapping.interpretation: Equation (5) exhausts modeled output between labor and capital. ALCD2 is a candidate for a gross factor-income closure; ALCD0 retains net production/import taxes in the GDP denominator. Choosing factor cost is an explicit modeling convention, not a uniquely identified empirical calibration.
remaining_gates: Review valuation and tax treatment for every baseline income/output quantity, including the GDP denominator in research intensity.
Retain gross versus net capital-income consistency with depreciation and gross rental rates.
Review the equal-compensation imputation for self-employed and the domestic versus resident population bridge.
Do not treat the complementary adjusted gross operating surplus as household wealth, disposable income or a net investment return.
Keep all other Portugal calibration and structural gates open; a single accounting identity does not authorize country execution.
